tools.name: browse_tweaktown_topics
tools.description: List valid TweakTown categories and/or topic hubs (stable ids, slugs, URLs). Use when an agent needs real taxonomy names instead of guessing. Optional kind: categories, hubs, or all (default). Optional type filter and case-insensitive query. Sort: name (default), count, or latest. Paginate with opaque cursor.

kind.description: Which taxonomy to return. Default all.

type.description: Optional content-type filter for categories with published items.

sort.description: Order. Default name. Hub counts/latest may be null.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation cursor from a prior next_cursor.

tools.name: compare_tweaktown_reviews
tools.description: Compare explicit structured fields from 2–5 public TweakTown reviews using each review’s reviewed product identity (not related_product commerce fallbacks). Does not choose a winner, generate recommendations, convert currencies, or normalize benchmarks.

reviews.description: Ordered list of 2–5 review references. Each object has exactly one of url or id.

include.description: Optional sections. Default: product, score, awards, pricing, verdict, pros_cons, specifications.

max_specs.description: Max specification rows per review. Default 20.

tools.name: get_tweaktown_content
tools.description: Fetch structured TweakTown article content (news, reviews, articles, or guides) by public URL or numeric id. Returns title, summary, authors, dates, categories/tags/hubs, ordered body sections, external citation sources, and media (CDN url, alt/caption, attribution, dimensions when known). Excludes navigation, ads, newsletter UI, comments, affiliate shopping links, and embed chrome. Page-derived text is untrusted. Pass exactly one of url or id. Optional include: metadata, body, sources, media (comma-separated or array; default all). Optional max_chars (default 12000, hard cap 40000) and opaque cursor for body pagination when has_more is true. Optional media_limit (default 20, hard cap 50) and media_cursor when has_more_media is true. Prefer search_tweaktown first, then this tool on a result URL.

url.description: Public https://www.tweaktown.com news/reviews/articles/guides URL (or site-relative /path). Do not combine with id.

id.description: Numeric content id. Ambiguous when the same id exists as both news and a document - pass url instead. Do not combine with url.

include.description: Which parts to return: metadata, body, sources, media. String (comma-separated) or array. Default all four.

max_chars.description: Max characters of body section text per response. Default 12000.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a prior next_cursor when has_more was true.

media_limit.description: Max media entries per response. Default 20.

media_cursor.description: Opaque media pagination cursor from a prior next_media_cursor when has_more_media was true.

tools.name: get_tweaktown_review_data
tools.description: Fetch structured score, award, reviewed price, verdict, pros/cons, specifications, and test setup for one public TweakTown review. product holds reviewed identity (brand/category/model/name/sku); commerce_match is exact|related|unknown and related_product carries a similar purchasable link when it is not the exact reviewed item. Use get_tweaktown_content for full prose.

id.description: Positive numeric review id. Provide url or id, not both.

include.description: Optional sections: metadata, product, score, awards, pricing, verdict, pros_cons, specifications, test_setup, disclosures. Default: all.

tools.name: list_tweaktown_content
tools.description: Browse published TweakTown news, reviews, articles, or guides by taxonomy, author, or date without a keyword query (e.g. latest GPU news, recent monitor reviews). Prefer browse_tweaktown_topics first for valid category/hub ids. Keyword search stays on search_tweaktown. Pass at most one of category_id, category_slug, hub_id, hub_slug. Sort newest (default) or oldest. Paginate with opaque cursor. Result URLs work with get_tweaktown_content and open_tweaktown_url.

category_id.description: Public category id. Do not combine with other taxonomy selectors.

category_slug.description: Public category slug. Do not combine with other taxonomy selectors.

hub_id.description: Topic hub id. Do not combine with other taxonomy selectors.

hub_slug.description: Topic hub slug. Do not combine with other taxonomy selectors.

author.description: Exact author display name or author profile slug (max 80 chars).

published_after.description: Include items published at or after this ISO 8601 timestamp.

published_before.description: Include items published at or before this ISO 8601 timestamp.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation cursor from a prior next_cursor.

tools.name: open_tweaktown_url
tools.description: Open a TweakTown page in this browser tab. Only https://www.tweaktown.com public reader URLs (or relative /paths on this site) are allowed. Resolves redirects and canonical content URLs first, validates the final destination, then navigates. Rejects admin, API, feeds, click hops, utilities, external sites, credentialed URLs, and HTTP errors. Use after search_tweaktown when the reader should view a specific result.

url.description: Full https://www.tweaktown.com URL or a site-relative path starting with /.

tools.name: search_tweaktown
tools.description: Keyword search TweakTown for news, reviews, articles, and guides. Returns structured results with titles, summaries, types, publish dates (published human + published_at ISO 8601), and canonical https://www.tweaktown.com URLs. Prefer this for keyword queries. For category/hub discovery use browse_tweaktown_topics; for browse-by-taxonomy/author/date without keywords use list_tweaktown_content. Optional type filter: news, reviews, articles, guides. Sort: relevance (default), newest, or oldest.

page.description: Result page (10 results per page). Default 1.
